title: Sunday’s Emerald Coast Escape with King Bed
description:
Remodeled oceanfront condo with private balcony overlooking one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, king-size bed and deck chairs to enjoy spectacular sunsets. Beautiful walk-in tiled shower and new amenities. 50" TV with cable and free WIFI. Enjoy the convenience of having a full kitchen and all the utensils. Wake up and enjoy your breakfast sunrise and coffee from the private balcony. March 15th-October 31st Provided 2 free beach chairs and umbrella ($45/day value). Condo on 5th floor

The space
Welcome to our hidden emerald coast gem, a recently remodeled haven adorned with top-of-the-line finishes. From the charming shiplap walls to the designer kitchen boasting white cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and a stunning glass tile backsplash, every detail has been carefully chosen for a truly luxurious experience. The condo is tastefully decorated with all-new designer furnishings, ensuring a stylish and comfortable stay.

Additionally, the prime location allows you to take leisurely strolls to Pier Park or Margaritaville, immersing yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the area.

Unwind and enjoy romantic sunsets from the privacy of your own balcony, offering breathtaking views. This condo is an ideal choice for a couple's getaway, providing a tranquil retreat to reconnect and create lasting memories.

Onsite amenities include a convenient coin-operated laundry room, a pool that is seasonally heated for your comfort, elevators for easy access, and a delightful dining experience at Flipper's Beach Restaurant (Open Seasonally). Additionally, vending machines are available for your convenience, and a designated BBQ area awaits for memorable grilling experiences. Parking is available for one vehicle during your stay.

Please note that as of March 2021, the entire building is designated as non-smoking, ensuring a clean and fresh environment for all guests to enjoy.

Discover the hidden gem of the emerald coast and immerse yourself in a truly remarkable experience. Book your stay now and indulge in the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and relaxation.

Other things to note
Please remember to pack beach towels for your stay as we do not provide beach towels. We only provide bath towels. Thank you

reviews.text: We loved staying at this condo! The location was excellent — very walkable to several restaurants and attractions, with easy beach access just steps away. Diego’s right across the street was a huge bonus and quickly became one of our favorite spots. The condo itself was very clean and well maintained, and the elevators worked great with no issues during our stay. Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would definitely stay here again!

Overall based on what we like and compared to multiple Florida beach stays over the years, this was as close to perfect as I think we could ever get. We would prefer to stay here again if we come back to PCB. Single glitch was door code check in, although that was quickly  resolved by the host. Other than that, fantastic experience in every way.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Beautiful, clean condo with an amazing oceanfront view. The balcony is perfect for morning coffee and sunset views. Very comfortable bed, modern finishes, and a fully stocked kitchen made the stay easy and relaxing. Beach chairs and umbrella are available, which is a great bonus.
Great location—close to Pier Park and restaurants, but still peaceful. Would definitely stay here again!

The place was very beautiful and clean with a great view. The bathroom speaker and lights were a fun addition. The pool was very nice and always clean. The elevators were a little slow and under maintenance during our time there. The host was very nice and responsive and gave clear instructions. Overall, it was a very nice and peaceful stay.
Amazing place!  Was within walking distance to Pier Park and lots of restaurants.  Very clean and the perfect amount of space for two people.  Would absolutely recommend!

The pictures you see online are exactly how you see it. It was very clean and the view was beautiful. Unfortunately the weather wasn't the best for us so we didn't enjoy as much. I would most defintely come again. The only thing that was a slight inconvenience was the contruction in the parking lot. Other than that everything was awesome.

This place was beautifully decorated, super clean and comfortable. The building sits right on the sand with a stunning view of the ocean from your balcony. The kitchen and amenities were well stocked with everything you needed. Host provided clear instructions and helpful information to make your stay a great experience.
Absolutely 5 stars!!⭐️

We spent the weekend here and it was so peaceful. The place was exactly as described and the photos were spot on. Fantastic shower too! The hosts were very communicative and helpful with clear instructions and super quick responses.
Fully stocked with anything you could possibly need for your stay.
We’re hoping to book another of their properties in the future!

We stayed here to celebrate my husband’s birthday, and it made our first trip to Panama City truly special! The Airbnb looked exactly like the photos, and the beach view was absolutely amazing. We loved how easy it was to access the beach as well.
Jamie was incredibly proactive and made the entire experience seamless. She provided clear instructions for everything ahead of time, so we never had to worry about where to go or what to do. We didn’t even need to reach out with questions because she had already covered everything so thoughtfully.
Overall, a wonderful experience — would 100% recommend!

Amazing place to stay. Clean, nice decor, beautiful view, quiet, and great location. All details communicated very well along with codes and passwords. Parking was easy, close to elevators that have a luggage carts nearby. able to walk to pier park and restaurants easily. cart rentals very close by,  not able to park carts  at the condo but you can easily walk to and from cart rental area. Beach easily accessed 2 chairs and an umbrella provided and set up near beach access. It was the perfect getaway.

Such a gem. We loved the place It was beautiful, clean, comfy, and had amazing sunset views from the balcony. Bed was so comfortable (which isn’t usually the case in rentals).
Such a great location where you can walk to restaurants, bars, and pier in Panama City beach.

A stunning little Studio Condo looking out at the ocean! Absolutely beautiful ocean and beach decor everywhere. The kitchen had everything I needed, the big shower had a nice strong water flow, which felt really good in the shower. King size bed with plenty of pillows and an extra blanket, which I needed because it was actually chilly when I went. I sat on the balcony every day in the big chairs, looking at the ocean and walked on the beach every day. This place is brimming with charm.
The condo was everything that was advertized. Great view of the beach. Jaime was in frequent contact via texts and was responsive to our texts as well. Couldn't ask for more!
It was amazing! The room looked just like the photos and it was close to so many things. Jamie was great and really quick with responding. Would definitely book here again!
I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made check-in super easy. I would definitely stay here again.
This place is beautiful! The ocean view from the private deck was wonderful for watching the sunset and peaceful spot for a morning coffee!! Definitely loved this place!!

This place was everything they advertised.  It was very very clean and comfortable.  The view from the balcony was amazing.  Sunsets were unreal.   Very very short walk  to the complimentary beach chairs and umbrella!  Great restaurants within walking distance.   Safe free parking.   Great hosts with very responsive communication!  Would highly recommend!

Jamie and Todd were super responsive with any questions we had and provided us with detailed yet simple and very easy check in/out instructions. The condo was beautiful and very clean, with wonderful ocean view.  it was an easy walk to pier park and other shops and restaurants. And of course just steps to the beach! Everything was wonderful.

This is such a cute place with beautiful beach decor to complete the stay!  Jamie and Todd were proactive and very responsive to questions and comments.   So relaxing and close to many shops, restaurants.  We couldn't be happier with our stay or our hosts!!  Hands down the best trip we had in a while.  Thanks to you both for making it easy to vacation!
Awesome spot. The place was very clean, and in an ideal location. Noise levels at night were at a minimum if that is what you’re looking for. Very peaceful and scenic!
Stay was fine but parking was a nightmare.  We should have been told about it being resurfaced before we rented.
reviews.response:
Hi Jan, thank you for your feedback—we’re glad to hear the rest of your stay was enjoyable.
We do want to clarify that we notified guests about the parking lot resurfacing prior to check-in, as soon as we received the information from our HOA. We understand the inconvenience this may have caused and truly appreciate your patience while the work was being completed.

reviews.text: Super responsive and the place was perfect for our little get away. Within walking distance to pier park (a little less than a mile) and so many other restaurants. We can’t wait to come back!
Everything about our stay was great for our honeymoon we had such a great time. When we had problems Jamie did a great job staying in contact with us we will definitely be back!
We truly enjoyed our stay, thank you so much! Great area for the beach, restaurants, and lots of fun things to do! The condo is decorated so nice and made our stay very comfortable!

title: Futuristic Bed & Breakfast!
description:
Enjoy your own Space Capsule with adjustable mood lighting, air control & lights. Sleep in comfort with our memory foam mattresses, pillows, satin sheets and faux fur blankets! Make yourself a hot cup of coffee or tea with anything from our coffee/snack bar while you await your breakfast order. Please keep in mind that you are renting a bed in a shared room/house your "space" will be private and have its own key card access. Feel free to ask any questions!

Registration Details
Exempt
room_type: Shared room in bed and breakfast

reviews.text: Eclectic place to spend the night.  Recommend for lone traveler.  The space pod bunk is unique and clean.  My only issue was the ac was not sufficient to keep up with Florida heat.  Nathan was a great host and grilled out for all the guests.  Thanks for the hot dogs and mac/cheese.
Nathan was a responsive owner and was very friendly. He walked me through the set up and everything was transparent it felt like a community and that’s pretty cool. I recommend Nathan’s place.

I’ve never stayed in a pod setup before, safe to say it was great!
Friendly host, all the guests were good company if you wanted that, and left you to yourself if that’s what you wanted aswell.
As a solo traveler I’d recommend every time.

I was interested to see a Capsule Hotel style BnB, and Nathan did not disappoint. A lively, yet quiet place to rest your head, with an insanely cool atmosphere. The pod was comfy at 6'2 and Nathan made Tacos.
10/10 - will come again
overall good stay. i personally like light and fresh air, fyi there are no windows...the people staying there are good peeps!
Great place better than I could imagine. Meet a few new friends that were also staying there too!
Nathan was an AWESOME host, who answered all my questions and was so kind to me.  His place is definitely a unique experience, and I enjoyed my stay.
Cost effective
Magic place
Wahrlich eine nicht alltägliche Unterkunft, unbedingt ausprobieren. Wäre gerne noch länger geblieben.

title: Steps from the beach QUEEN SUITE w/ Private Balcon
description:
Welcome to a more intentional way to stay. Situated in the high-energy center of Panama City Beach, this one-bedroom residence is a study in monochromatic refinement. While the Gulf is just steps away, this second-floor suite offers an elevated perspective and a private balcony overlooking the neighborhood and the surrounding grounds—built to help you find your own rhythm.

The space
The Walk-Through
The experience begins as you step away from the sun-drenched pulse of Front Beach Road and into a space defined by soft textures and clean lines.

The Living Area: A minimalist sanctuary grounded by herringbone tile flooring. The space features a sleek, modern sofa and invisible technology, including a 50-inch Roku TV and high-speed Wi-Fi. Central heating and air keep the climate perfectly tailored to your comfort.

The Balcony: Step through the glass slider to your private outdoor space. Overlooking the neighborhood and the property grounds, it is a quiet spot for a morning coffee or a rhythmic evening reset away from the main road.

The Kitchen: The floor plan flows into a bespoke culinary space where everything is on purpose. Dual-tone cabinetry pairs matte cream uppers with lower cabinets fully surfaced in a warm wood veneer. While the space features professional stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops, we have kept the design streamlined—manual dishwashing is required as there is no dishwasher.

The Bath: The transition continues into a spa-inspired environment clad in floor-to-ceiling cream and gold marble tile. High-contrast matte black fixtures and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower provide a sharp, modern ritual to end your day.

The Bedroom: Retreat to the Queen bedroom, a quiet environment designed for a restful reset.

Guest access
A Seamless Experience
We prioritize a quiet atmosphere and a private, self-sufficient stay.

Contactless Arrival: To maintain the sanctuary of our space, access is via a secure digital smart lock. Your unique entry code and detailed instructions are always sent the day of your arrival.

Invisible Support: While we do not maintain a traditional on-site front desk, we are never out of reach. We remain available through the messaging platform for a prompt response and are always prepared to assist on-site should the need arise.

reviews.text: My s/o and I came down here for my birthday during memorial weekend. Overall the experience was amazing! The unit was very nice, clean, and gave an overall modern experience. They are very helpful with any questions that may arise during your stay as well. It was everything you would want an Airbnb to be. Overall 10/10 definitely book here!
reviews.response:
We are thrilled to hear everything was to your liking and thank you so much for your thoughtful review!
We can't wait to welcome you back!

reviews.text: Great place! Literally across the street from the beach. Incredibly clean & easy to communicate with! Only warning is that it’s next to a bar, so it can get noisy if that’s something you’re trying to steer away from. For us it was perfect - walkable to everything we needed and wanted to do! I would stay again.
reviews.response: Thank you, Annie! We're thrilled you enjoyed your stay and found our location perfect for your needs. Your feedback means a lot to us, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for another wonderful visit!

reviews.text:
⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️
Absolutely loved my stay at Octa Collection. The host was incredibly accommodating and responsive from start to finish. The space itself was immaculate, modern, and thoughtfully designed with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Even the scent of the property stood out in the best way. Parking was easy, the location was perfect, and it’s just steps away from the beach. Communication was always fast and helpful. I truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience and can’t wait to come back!
reviews.response:
Thank you for the five stars and for all the kind words about your stay.
It's so awesome to hear that our host was responsive and accommodating, and that you felt right at home in the space. We put a lot of care into the design and details—especially the vibe and the cleanliness—so knowing you noticed everything (even the scent!) makes all the difference.
We truly can't wait to welcome you back to Octa Collection!

reviews.text:
The place was amazing!!!
me and my wife stayed there for our honeymoon, and it was perfect for us
first of all everything was perfectly clean, it had all of the needed utilities like the shower soaps, dishwashing soaps and paper towels
The bed was very comfortable as well as all of the sheets and towels were soft and nice!
The both TVs worked and are good quality in the living room and in the bedroom
the AC worked perfectly and shower was very comfortable
The location is perfect right across the beach and bunch of coffee shops and restaurants, didn’t even need to use the car!
The host was amazing, responded instantly to any questions
The only thing is that there is no washing or drying machine but they provide service for it!
reviews.response:
Vladyslav,
We’re so honored that you chose to celebrate such a special occasion with us, and we want you to know that we truly value your feedback. We’ve already started updating our guest books to make the information clearer and help prevent any confusion for future guests.
Thank you for your kind words. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we’d love to welcome you back anytime.
